speech_text:
Trump administration drops 760,000 Americans from ACA coverage, citing fraud.

Citing widespread fraud, JD Vance and Dr. Mehmet Oz announced 760,000 Americans had been kicked off health insurance purchased in the federal ACA marketplace. The move raises lots of questions.
